Create a jarl.toml configuration file

Source: R/52_use_jarl.R
use_jarl.Rd

Writes a jarl.toml configuration file for jarl, the R linter written in Rust. The file pins down the linting behaviour of every jarl invocation in the project, so the command line, the editor integration and the continuous integration workflow all agree.

  • jarl.toml is looked up by jarl in the current working directory, then in its parent directories, and finally in the user configuration directory. jarl reads a single configuration file, the closest one wins.

  • All lint options live in the [lint] table. Command line flags always take precedence over the file.

  • [lint.per-file-ignores] must come last in the file, otherwise the options written after it are parsed as glob patterns; the generated file does not use that table.

  • When path is the root of an R package (contains a DESCRIPTION file), jarl.toml is also added to .Rbuildignore (inside a scoped project, so the active project of the calling session is restored afterwards).

Read the configuration reference for the full list of options, and the continuous integration guide to run jarl on every push with the etiennebacher/setup-jarl action.

Usage

use_jarl(path = NULL, overwrite = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to the directory where jarl.toml should be written. If NULL (the default), the current working directory is used.

overwrite

Logical. If TRUE, overwrite an existing jarl.toml file. Defaults to FALSE.

...

Must be empty. Reserved for future arguments.

Value

Invisibly returns the path to the created jarl.toml file.

Examples

tmp <- tempdir()
use_jarl(path = tmp, overwrite = TRUE)
#> ✔ Created /tmp/RtmplPre7l/jarl.toml.
#> • Read jarl's editor support
#>   (<https://jarl.etiennebacher.com/reference/config-file>) to learn how to
#>   invoke jarl in your preferred editor.
#> • Read jarl's continuous integration
#>   (<https://jarl.etiennebacher.com/howto/ci>) to learn about GHA workflows that
#>   continuously run linting checks.
readLines(file.path(tmp, "jarl.toml"))
#>  [1] "# jarl configuration file"                                                 
#>  [2] "# Reference: https://jarl.etiennebacher.com/reference/config-file"         
#>  [3] ""                                                                          
#>  [4] "[lint]"                                                                    
#>  [5] "# Rules enabled on top of jarl's default rule set. The `TESTTHAT` group is"
#>  [6] "# opt-in, so it has to be requested explicitly."                           
#>  [7] "extend-select = [\"TESTTHAT\"]"                                            
#>  [8] ""                                                                          
#>  [9] "# Files or directories that jarl should not lint."                         
#> [10] "exclude = [\"R/vendor-*.R\"]"                                              
#> [11] ""                                                                          
#> [12] "# Also lint the R code inside `@examples` and `@examplesIf` tags"          
#> [13] "# (the default)."                                                          
#> [14] "check-roxygen = true"                                                      
#> [15] ""                                                                          
#> [16] "# Rules that `jarl check --fix` is allowed to fix (all rules by default)." 
#> [17] "# fixable = [\"PERF\"]"                                                    
#> [18] ""                                                                          
#> [19] "# Rules that `jarl check --fix` must leave untouched."                     
#> [20] "# unfixable = [\"undesirable_function\"]"
